using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.common.tests;

public class FormatTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;

    public FormatTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_EmptyString_ReturnsDefaultBindAny()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("", 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length > 0);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => ep is IPEndPoint ipEp && ipEp.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Any));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_NullString_ReturnsDefaultBindAny()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(null, 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length > 0);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => ep is IPEndPoint ipEp && ipEp.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Any));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIpAddress_ReturnsSingleEndpoint()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("127.0.0.1", 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Single(result);
        var endpoint = Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(result[0]);
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Parse("127.0.0.1"), endpoint.Address);
        Assert.Equal(6379, endpoint.Port);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_ReturnsLoopbackEndpoints()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length > 0);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => ep is IPEndPoint ipEp && ipEp.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Loopback));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("invalidhost123")]
    [InlineData("nonexistent.example.com")]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_UnresolvableHostname_LogsErrorNoIpAddresses(string hostname)
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("No IP address found for hostname") && v.ToString().Contains(hostname)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_ExceptionDuringDnsLookup_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange - use invalid hostname that throws
        var invalidHostname = new string('a', 256); // Likely to cause exception

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidHostname, 6379, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error while trying to resolve hostname") && v.ToString().Contains(invalidHostname)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_EmptyList_ProtectedMode_ReturnsLoopback()
    {
        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList("", 6379, out var endpoints, out var error, protectedMode: true, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(success);
        Assert.NotNull(endpoints);
        Assert.Contains(endpoints, ep => ep is IPEndPoint ipEp && ipEp.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Loopback));
        Assert.Null(error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_InvalidAddress_ReturnsFalseWithError()
    {
        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList("invalidhost", 6379, out var endpoints, out var error, logger: _mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(success);
        Assert.Null(endpoints);
        Assert.Equal("invalidhost", error);
    }
}
